label: K Records
release_notes: Reissue of the 11-track cassette Chicago's Kai Slater (also of Lifeguard and Dwaal Troupe) self-released as a teenager in 2023, about 50 hand-dubbed copies.
Covers and rough recordings, remastered; out on Perennial / K Records (LP/CD, cat. PRNL071/KLP320).
Released with a new single, Saturday Sun. NACC #15 the week of Oct. 1.
Reviewers compare it to The Kinks, early Who and Guided By Voices.
Title nods to Mods Mayday '79, a compilation from a London show with Secret Affair, Beggar, The Mods and Squire (Why Now).
draft_comment: Kai Slater's teenage bedroom cassette, cleaned up for the rest of us. Kinks and early Who by way of a Chicago basement. Fuzzy, catchy, over in a flash.

tracks.title: It's A Mod Mod World
tracks.notes: Cover of "It's A Mod Mod World" by Squire (Mods Mayday '79, 1979), written by Anthony Meynell (SecondHandSongs).

tracks.title: Face of Youth Today
tracks.notes: Cover of "The Face of Youth Today" by Squire (1979 UK 7-inch, per Discogs).

tracks.title: I've Got You on My Mind
B-A-B-Y Baby Luv
tracks.notes: Cover of "B-A-B-Y Baby Love" by Squire (Mods Mayday '79, 1979).

tracks.title: Tonight's The Night
tracks.notes: Cover of The Mods; the cleanest-sounding recording here (POST-TRASH). On the NACC Top 50 playlist. Original is from the live compilation Mods Mayday '79 (May 1979, Bridge House show).

tracks.title: Live Without Her Love
tracks.notes: Cover of a Squire song (Mods Mayday '79). Slater adds psychedelic soloing and harmonica (POST-TRASH). Bonus track on the limited CD (Bandcamp).

tracks.title: Friday Night
tracks.notes: One review credits the original to Beggar, another Mods Mayday '79 act, and hears a live-sounding recording with feedback (Pop Fantasma).

tracks.title: Love Only Me
tracks.notes: Cover of a song by The Mods (Mods Mayday '79). POST-TRASH calls it and Let Me Be The One more energetic, almost punk.

tracks.title: Let Me Be The One
tracks.notes: Cover of a song by The Mods (Mods Mayday '79). POST-TRASH: more energetic, but whimsical.

tracks.title: Days of Change
tracks.notes: One of the more subdued tracks: no percussion, Slater on acoustic guitar with muffled vocals (POST-TRASH).
